RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for  ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the April 23, 2008/Vaisakha 3, 1930 (Saka)

(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home
Affairs; Information and Broadcasting; Labour and Employment;
Rural Development; Science and  Technology; Textiles)
Total number of questions  20
133
Meeting shortage of officers in the
Army
*421. SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANW ARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
 Will the Minister of  DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Short-Service Commission-
ed Officers and Officers from Territorial
Units, after usual NDA pattern training,
can significantly contribute towards
meeting the shortage of over 11,000 officers
in the Army; and
(b)  if so, whether an indepth study
will be undertaken through internationally
or nationally renowned Defence experts
in this regard so that maximum number of
our boys from schools/colleges are
motivated towards joining the Defence
Forces?
Loss of jobs in SSI units due to
appreciation in Rupee value
*422. SHRI  RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of  LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that due to
appreciation in value of Indian Rupee
against dollar and 4 lakh units being closed
in small industry sector, 13 lakh workers
are likely to be rendered jobless during
2007; and
(b)  if not, the assessment of
Government thereto?
Rehabilitation of victims of Tsunami
*423. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of  HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether all the victims of Tsunami
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

134
of 2004 have by now been rehabilitated
and provided with dwelling units;
(b)  if not, the number of those still not
provided with dwelling units, State and
Union Territory-wise;
(c)  the time likely to be taken to
complete the task of rehabilitating all the
victims;
(d)  Central assistance so far provided
to the States and Union Territories for the
purpose, unit-wise; and
(e)  how much further Central assistance
is likely to be given to complete the
rehabilitation work?
Exports and imports under FTA
*424. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of  COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether  international trade between
India and several other countries is being
carried out under the Free Trade Agreement
(FTA);
(b)  if so, the details thereof alongwith
the names of the countries with which FTA
has been signed;
(c)  the reductions in taxes applicable
under the agreement; and
(d)  the average value of annual exports
and imports made under the agreement
during the last three years?
Villages connected with main roads
*425. SHRI  SU. THIRUNAVUK-
KARASAR: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a)  how many kilometres distance was
constructed under the Pradhan Mantri
Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) in 2007-08;
(b)  how many villages are yet to be
connected with the main roads; and
(c)  the total number of roads and
kilometres requested by all State
Governments, State-wise under the
scheme?
Terrorist and drug syndicates using
encrypted chatroom
*426. DR. (SHRIMATI) NAJMA
A. HEPTULLA:
SHRI MAHENDRA
MOHAN:
 Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government is aware that
terrorists and drug syndicates have
increasingly taken to using encrypted
chatrooms and e-payment gateways to
transfer key documents and carry out
transactions;
(b)  whether in a recent drug bust case
in Delhi, it was found that the syndicate
was using Skype chatroom, an encrypted
chat forum difficult for intelligence agencies
to crack, to transfer documents;
(c)  if so, how Government is monitoring
world Wide Web to bust the rackets;
(d) how many such rackets have been
busted so far and the people arrested;
(e) whether our law enforcement
agencies are capable to deal such type of
crimes; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Violent incidents in Orissa
*427. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether violent incidents had taken
place in some parts of Orissa in and after
December, 2007;
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

135
(b)  whether he had visited the violence
affected areas; and
(c)  if so, the reasons for the occurrence
of violent incidents in those areas?
Extreme change in weather patterns
*428. SHRIMATI JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of  EARTH SCIENCES
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Indian Meteorological
Department has studied the extreme
changes reflected in the weather patterns
in the northern and other parts of the
country this year;
(b)  whether any observations have been
made on the causes of extreme weather or
the trends to come; and
(c)  if so, the details thereof?
Opening of new technical institutes
in the country
*429. SHRI B. J. PANDA:
MS. MABEL REBELLO:
 Will the Minister of  LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government proposed to
open 400 new technical institutes in the
country to meet the demand of skilled staff;
(b)  if so, the details thereof inter alia
indicating those which are proposed to be
opened in the fast industrializing States of
Orissa and Jharkhand;
(c)  whether Centre has promised to
fund the project; and
(d)  if so, the details thereof?
Review of FDI policy
*430. SHRI  RAMDAS AGARW AL:
Will the Minister of  COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government has reviewed
the Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) policy
to boost foreign capital inflows;
(b)  what changes are expected to boost
the same which peaked to $ 16 billion
through last fiscal year; and
(c) what are Governments expectations
during current fiscal year indicating the
likely inflows by the end of March this
year?
Conversion of EPZs into SEZs for tax
benefits
*431. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD : Will
the Minister of  COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government is aware that
many Export Processing Zones (EPZs)
have been converted into Special Economic
Zones (SEZs) only for tax benefits; and
(b)  if so, how does Government justify
increase of exports, production and
employment due to SEZs?
Loss due to Tsunami and funds
allocated and spent
*432. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the Minister of  HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government is aware that
more than three years after the Tsunami,
only about one-fourth of the funds allocated
have been spent;
(b)  if so, the reasons therefor;
(c)  the human and cattle loss incurred
due to Tsunami, State-wise;
(d) the allocation and the amount spent
in each State, State-wise; and
(e) the reaction of Government thereto?

136
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Unwillingness of bankers to finance
units in SEZs
*433. SHRI O. T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of  COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government is aware that
bankers are not willing to finance units in
Special Economic Zones (SEZs) because
they are not able to get transferable rights
on the land and building;
(b)  if so, whether Government thinks
that development of industries in SEZs will
be a big problem and will only confines
itself to big industrial houses; and
(c) if so, how does Government plan to
overcome this problem?
Rajasthan Bill to control illegal
activities
*434. SHRI  KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI:  Will the Minister of  HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government proposes to
make any specific legislation to check illegal
activities of anti-social persons like
usurpers of property, black marketeers of
wine;
(b)  should the State Government not
take any action to control such illegal
activities;
(c)  should District Magistrate not be
empowered to maintain law and order in
the district; and
(d)  if the reasons for not giving assent
to the Bill of Rajasthan formulated to
control the illegal activities of such anti-
social persons?
Internal assessment report on
Naxalite situation
*435. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR: Will
the Minister of  HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether the Naxal organizations are
strengthening their base and their activities
are growing in many States in our country,
particularly in Uttar Pradesh;
(b)  if so, the details thereof;
(c)  whether Government has proposed
to formulate any concrete plans to counter
the activities of Naxalities in the country;
(d)  if so, the details thereof; and
(e)  whether any internal assessment
report has been prepared by Government
on the Naxalite situation in the country?
Manufacture of gold jewellery by
MMTC
*436. SHRI BANWARI LAL
KANCHHAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether Minerals and Metals
Trading Corporation (MMTC) has decided
to enter into gold jewellery manufacturing
industry at a large scale; and
(b)  if so, the details thereof?
Shortage of technical staff at sub-
stations in sub-divisional areas
*437. SHRI BHAGIRATHI MAJHI:
Will the Minister of  INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a)  whether Government is aware that
in sub-divisional areas the work of many
sub-stations has been completed;

137
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, whether these stations have
not been operated/opened due to lack of
adequate technical staff;
(c)  if so, how many such stations are
there in Orissa and details regarding them;
and
(d)  what steps the Ministry has taken
for their early functioning?
Implementation of recommendations
of Malimath Committee
*438. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a)  how many recommendations out of
150 recommendations to revamp the
criminal justice system, made by Dr.
(Justice) U.S. Malimath have been
accepted by Government;
(b)  how many of them have been
implemented through statutory
amendments or otherwise;
(c)  how many are proposed to be
implemented; and
(d)  the details thereof?
Improving condition of jails in the
country
*439. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI:  Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government is considering
to improve the condition of different jails
in the country;
(b)  if so, the details thereof; and
(c)  the financial assistance likely to be
given to each State by Government?
Cooperation with China, Russia, USA
and Israel on defence issues
*440. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of  DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a)  the details of defence sectors in
which India is seeking/providing co-
operation from China, Russia, USA and
Israel;
(b) whether this includes import and
export; and
(c)  whether there is any mechanism for
permanent/temporary exchange of experts?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 17th April, 2008 Secretary-General.
Chaitra 28, 1930 (Saka)
